name: qtn-syntax-highlighting-workspace
description: Workspace root for QTN Syntax Highlighting project

scripts.compile: npm run compile:client && npm run compile:server
scripts.webpack: npm run webpack:client && npm run webpack:server
scripts.bundle:server: npm run compile:server && npm run webpack:server
scripts.test: npm run check:grammar && npm run test:runtimes && npm --prefix packages/language-server test && npm --prefix packages/language-server run test:integration && npm --prefix packages/vscode-extension test && npm --prefix packages/vscode-extension run test:snap
